description: Micro decision check for ONE DeFi cover, priced for high-frequency agent use (default $0.49 vs $4.99 for the full analysis): answers "does this cover actually pay for my risk?" with the clause-by-clause coverage gap map (covered / conditional / excluded, with notes) plus all red-flag texts. Cryptographically signed (attestation field). Paid via x402 (USDC); auto-pays if REPUTA_PAYER_PRIVATE_KEY is set. Slugs from reputa_cover_list; response shape at /api/cover/v1/schema.
name: reputa_cover_check
